Features.Title: Nine appearance choices
Features.Description: Open Settings > Appearance to choose Light, Dark, Same as Windows, Classic Blue & Orange, Graphite & Orange, Midnight & Gold, Teal & Ivory, Slate & Blue, or Charcoal & Emerald. Your choice is saved for this Windows account. Existing preferences are kept. Over and short amounts remain green and red.

Features.Title: Cleaner batch search and sorting
Features.Description: Shift Cash Drop now has a compact toolbar directly above the records in all three layouts. Search batches with the magnifying-glass field, clear the search with X or Esc, and use the filter menu to sort by business date or batch number. Sync Health is beside these controls. Automatic sync setup remains protected for developer access.
